rules.sentence: Objectives: Identify clinical features that raise suspicion for tuberculous spondylitis in diverse patient populations.
Determine appropriate diagnostic strategies for tuberculous spondylitis.
Apply evidence-based anti-tuberculous chemotherapy regimens for patients with tuberculous spondylitis.
When diagnosed early, TB spondylitis can be treated conservatively in an effort to avoid complications.
However, late diagnosis often requires both medical and surgical interventions to manage progressive bone destruction, spine instability, kyphosis, and spinal cord damage.
